tier1_metros.name: New York

tier1_loan_types.name: Commercial Real Estate Loans
tier1_loan_types.intent: broadest search. Sponsor looking for a broker to source commercial real estate financing across any asset class and loan type.
tier1_loan_types.typical_deal_range: $5M to $200M+ across all CRE asset classes
tier1_loan_types.typical_products: Permanent (life company, CMBS, agency multifamily), bridge and transitional debt, construction and ground-up, SBA 504 / 7(a) owner-user, mezzanine and preferred equity, specialty (data center, cold storage, self-storage, hospitality)

tier1_loan_types.name: Multifamily Loans
tier1_loan_types.intent: multifamily-specific search. Apartment sponsor, syndicator, or developer.
tier1_loan_types.typical_products: Fannie Mae DUS (Small Balance, Target, Green Advantage), Freddie Mac Optigo (Target, SBL, Optigo Green), CMBS conduit, life insurance company permanent, value-add bridge (debt funds and mortgage REITs), ground-up construction, HUD 221(d)(4) and 223(f), workforce multifamily, affordable / LIHTC

tier1_loan_types.name: Bridge Loans
tier1_loan_types.intent: bridge-specific search. Transitional, value-add, acquisition, or repositioning.
tier1_loan_types.typical_products: Debt fund senior bridge, mortgage REIT bridge, construction bridge, acquisition bridge, value-add renovation bridge, predevelopment bridge, note purchase bridge, DIP financing

tier1_loan_types.name: Construction Loans
tier1_loan_types.typical_products: Bank construction (regional + national), debt fund non-bank construction, life company construction-to-permanent, HUD 221(d)(4), build-to-suit with credit tenant forward commitment, SBA 504 owner-user construction

tier1_loan_types.name: SBA Commercial Loans
tier1_loan_types.intent: SBA-specific search. Owner-user buying or building their own commercial property.
tier1_loan_types.typical_products: SBA 504 first mortgage + CDC debenture (up to 90% LTC), SBA 7(a) working capital + real estate, SBA express, owner-user manufacturing, owner-user medical / dental, owner-user restaurant and retail, owner-user warehouse
